en.introduction_text: Frontend / full-stack developer at I-MAS since September 2025. I build production web applications with React, TypeScript and Node.js, from understanding the problem to implementation and code review.
en.availability_text: Based in Barcelona. Interested in English-speaking teams in Denmark and Switzerland.
en.synopsis_title: From a functional problem to working software.
en.synopsis_text: At I-MAS, I investigate functional needs, assess technical options and implement frontend and backend changes. I integrate them into an existing codebase, submit merge requests and improve the solution through feedback from the team and tech lead.
